title: Realm 1: Painting the Web
description: Build your first webpage using tags, images, links, colors, and layout.

lessons.title: 1. Headings & Paragraphs
lessons.concept:
### Welcome to HTML! 🎨 HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It gives every webpage its skeleton! Elements are wrapped in opening and closing tags: - `

Big Title

` for the main heading - `

This is a paragraph of text.

` for text - `` for clickable buttons!
lessons.task:
Create an `

` heading with text `My Hero Quest` and a `

` paragraph with text `I am learning to code!`.
lessons.starterCode:
Hello World

Welcome to the web!
lessons.solution:
My Hero Quest

I am learning to code!
hints: Change the h1 to 'My Hero Quest' and p to 'I am learning to code!'

tests.description: Contains 'I am learning to code!' in p

lessons.title: 2. Buttons & Styling with CSS
lessons.concept:
### Adding Style with CSS
You can add colors, rounded corners, and glowing buttons using CSS:

```html
<button style="background-color: #38bdf8; color: #000; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: bold;">
  Launch Rocket 🚀
</button>
```
lessons.task: Create a `<button>` with style `background-color: gold; color: black;` and button text `Claim Reward ✨`.
lessons.solution:
<button style="background-color: gold; color: black; font-weight: bold; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px;">
  Claim Reward ✨
</button>
hints: Set background-color: gold; and text 'Claim Reward ✨'

title: HTML Document Structure
description: Learn the foundation of every HTML page.

lessons.title: 1. DOCTYPE
lessons.concept:
### DOCTYPE
Every HTML page needs a DOCTYPE. Think of it like a nametag telling the browser what language we are speaking!
hints: Put it at the very top

lessons.title: 2. html/head/body
lessons.concept:
### The HTML Skeleton
An HTML file is like a human body. The <head> is the brain (hidden thoughts), and the <body> is what you can see!
lessons.task: Create an html tag with head and body inside.

lessons.title: 3. title/meta, link/script
lessons.concept:
### Title and Links
The <title> is what shows up on the browser tab! We can also link other files like CSS or JavaScript.

lessons.title: 1. Headings & Paragraphs
lessons.concept:
### h1-h6 and p
Headings are like chapter titles in a book. h1 is the biggest, h6 is the smallest.
lessons.task: Add an h1 and an h2.

lessons.title: 2. Formatting Text
lessons.concept:
### strong, em, span
Use <strong> to make text bold, like a superhero flexing! <em> makes it italic.
lessons.task: Make a word bold using strong.

lessons.title: 3. Anchor Tags
lessons.concept:
### Links
Anchor tags <a> let you travel to other pages! Like magical portals.

lessons.title: 4. HTML Entities
lessons.concept:
### Special Characters
Need a copyright symbol? Use HTML entities like ©!

lessons.title: 1. Lists
lessons.concept:
### ul, ol, li
Need a shopping list? Use <ul> for bullets and <ol> for numbers. <li> is for each item.
lessons.task: Make a ul with two li items.

lessons.title: 2. Data Tables
lessons.concept:
### tables
Tables are like Excel sheets. thead is the header, tbody is the body, tr is a row, th is a header cell, td is a data cell.
lessons.task: Create a table with one row.

lessons.title: 3. Table Styling
lessons.concept:
### Table Borders
Tables look invisible by default. Let's add CSS to show borders!
lessons.task: Add a style attribute to table for border: 1px solid black.

lessons.title: 1. Images
lessons.concept: ### img src/alt Want to show a picture? Use the tag! Remember to use 'alt' text for screen readers.
lessons.task: Add an img tag with src 'cat.jpg'.

lessons.title: 2. Figure
lessons.concept:
### figure and figcaption
Group an image and its caption together like a museum display!

lessons.title: 3. Audio & Video
lessons.concept:
### Playing Media
Embed music or movies right in your page using <audio> and <video> tags.

lessons.title: 1. Forms
lessons.concept:
### form/input/label
Forms let users send data! Like filling out a survey.
lessons.task: Add a form with an input.

lessons.title: 2. Input Types
lessons.concept:
### Types of Inputs
Inputs can be passwords, dates, or checkboxes!

lessons.title: 3. Textarea & Select
lessons.concept:
### Long Text & Dropdowns
Need more space? Use textarea. Need choices? Use select and option.

lessons.title: 4. Form Validation
lessons.concept:
### Required Fields
Make sure users don't skip questions by adding the 'required' attribute.

lessons.title: 5. Buttons
lessons.concept:
### Button Types
Buttons can submit forms or just be clickable.

lessons.title: 1. Header, Main, Footer
lessons.concept:
### Semantic HTML
Use tags that describe the content! header for the top, main for the middle, footer for the bottom.

lessons.title: 2. Section & Article
lessons.concept:
### Grouping Content
Use section for distinct parts, and article for self-contained content like a blog post.

lessons.title: 3. Details & Dialog
lessons.concept:
### Interactive Semantics
Details creates a collapsible section, dialog creates a popup!

lessons.title: 4. Why Semantics Matter
lessons.concept:
### Screen Readers & SEO
Semantic HTML helps search engines and screen readers understand your page.

lessons.title: 1. Selectors
lessons.concept:
### Selectors
Use CSS to target elements, classes (.), or IDs (#).

lessons.title: 2. Combinators
lessons.concept:
### Combinators
Target elements inside other elements using space, >, +, or ~.

lessons.title: 3. Pseudo-classes
lessons.concept:
### Pseudo-classes
Target state like :hover when the mouse is over an element.

lessons.title: 4. Pseudo-elements
lessons.concept:
### Pseudo-elements
Target parts of an element like ::before or ::first-line.

lessons.title: 1. Box Model Basics
lessons.concept:
### Padding, Border, Margin
Every element is a box. Padding is inside, border is the edge, margin is outside.

lessons.title: 2. Box-sizing
lessons.concept:
### border-box
Make sizing easier by using box-sizing: border-box!

lessons.title: 3. Display Property
lessons.concept:
### Block vs Inline
Block takes full width, inline only takes what it needs.

lessons.title: 4. Overflow
lessons.concept:
### Overflow
What happens when content is too big? Use overflow: hidden or scroll.

lessons.title: 1. Colors
lessons.concept:
### Hex & RGB
Use hex codes like #ff0000 or rgb(255,0,0) for colors.

lessons.title: 2. Backgrounds
lessons.concept:
### Gradients
Make cool backgrounds with linear-gradient!

lessons.title: 3. Typography
lessons.concept:
### Fonts
Change the font-family, font-size, and font-weight.

lessons.title: 4. Google Fonts
lessons.concept:
### Web Fonts
Import custom fonts using @import or <link>.

lessons.title: 1. Display Flex
lessons.concept:
### Flexbox
Flexbox makes laying out items in a row or column super easy!

lessons.title: 2. Direction & Wrap
lessons.concept:
### Rows and Columns
Change direction with flex-direction.

lessons.title: 3. Justify Content
lessons.concept:
### Align Main Axis
Space items out with justify-content.

lessons.title: 4. Align Items
lessons.concept:
### Align Cross Axis
Center items vertically with align-items.

lessons.title: 5. Flex Sizing
lessons.concept:
### Grow and Shrink
Make items fill space with flex-grow.

lessons.title: 1. Display Grid
lessons.concept:
### CSS Grid
Grid is for 2D layouts! Rows and columns.

lessons.title: 2. Templates
lessons.concept:
### Columns and Rows
Define tracks with grid-template-columns.

lessons.title: 3. Grid Span
lessons.concept:
### Spanning
Make an item take up multiple columns.

lessons.title: 4. Template Areas
lessons.concept:
### Areas
Name your grid areas for easy layouts.

lessons.title: 5. Advanced Grid
lessons.concept:
### Auto-fit
Use auto-fit and minmax for responsive grids.

lessons.title: 1. Positioning
lessons.concept:
### Position
Move things around with position: relative, absolute, or fixed.

lessons.title: 2. Absolute & Fixed
lessons.concept:
### Absolute
Absolute positions relative to the nearest positioned ancestor.

lessons.title: 3. Z-Index
lessons.concept:
### Stacking
Control what's on top with z-index.

lessons.title: 4. Sticky
lessons.concept:
### Sticky headers
Make headers stick to the top when scrolling.

lessons.title: 1. Viewport Meta
lessons.concept:
### Mobile Support
The viewport meta tag is essential for mobile design.

lessons.title: 2. Media Queries
lessons.concept:
### Breakpoints
Change styles based on screen size with @media.
lessons.task: Add a media query for max-width 600px.

lessons.title: 3. Fluid Units
lessons.concept:
### rem, vw, vh
Use relative units for responsive text and sizing.

lessons.title: 4. Clamp & Min/Max
lessons.concept:
### clamp()
Set a minimum, preferred, and maximum size.

lessons.title: 5. Responsive Images
lessons.concept:
### srcset
Serve different images for different screens.

lessons.title: 1. Declaring Variables
lessons.concept:
### Custom Properties
Store colors in variables using --name.

lessons.title: 2. Using var()
lessons.concept:
### Using Variables
Use the var() function to apply your variables.

lessons.title: 3. Theming
lessons.concept:
### Dark Mode
Change variable values in media queries for dark mode.

lessons.title: 1. Transitions
lessons.concept:
### Smooth Changes
Animate state changes with transition.

lessons.title: 2. Transforms
lessons.concept:
### Translate & Scale
Move and resize elements with transform.

lessons.title: 3. Combining Transforms
lessons.concept:
### Multiple Transforms
Chain transforms together.

lessons.title: 4. 3D Transforms
lessons.concept:
### Perspective
Add 3D depth to elements.

lessons.title: 1. Keyframes
lessons.concept:
### @keyframes
Define custom animations step-by-step.

lessons.title: 2. Animation Shorthand
lessons.concept:
### Applying Animations
Apply keyframes to an element.

lessons.title: 3. Multi-step Animations
lessons.concept:
### Percentages
Add more steps using 50%, 75% etc.

lessons.title: 4. Performance
lessons.concept:
### will-change
Optimize animations for smooth rendering.

lessons.title: 1. Clip-path
lessons.concept:
### Custom Shapes
Cut elements into shapes with clip-path.

lessons.title: 2. Filter
lessons.concept:
### Visual Effects
Add blur or color shifts with filter.

lessons.title: 3. Backdrop-filter
lessons.concept:
### Glassmorphism
Blur what's behind an element.

lessons.title: 4. @supports
lessons.concept:
### Feature Detection
Check if a browser supports a feature.

lessons.title: 1. Contrast
lessons.concept:
### WCAG Contrast
Make sure text is readable against its background.

lessons.title: 2. ARIA Labels
lessons.concept:
### Screen Readers
Provide extra context with aria-label.

lessons.title: 3. Keyboard Navigation
lessons.concept:
### Focus
Style the :focus state for keyboard users.

lessons.title: 4. Alt Text
lessons.concept:
### Describing Images
Always use meaningful alt text for images.

lessons.title: 1. BEM Basics
lessons.concept:
### Block Element Modifier
Organize classes like .card__title--large.

lessons.title: 2. Components
lessons.concept:
### Reusability
Build independent, reusable CSS components.

lessons.title: 3. Utility Classes
lessons.concept:
### Utility First
Use small classes that do one thing, like .mt-4.

lessons.title: 1. Container Queries
lessons.concept:
### @container
Style elements based on container size, not viewport size.

lessons.title: 2. CSS Nesting
lessons.concept:
### Nesting
Write CSS selectors inside each other natively.

lessons.title: 3. :has() Selector
lessons.concept:
### Parent Selector
Target an element if it contains a specific child.
lessons.task: Style div if it has an img.

lessons.title: 4. Scroll Animations
lessons.concept:
### Scroll-timeline
Animate based on scroll position.

lessons.title: 1. Portfolio Landing
lessons.concept:
### Capstone 1
Build a complete hero section for a portfolio.

lessons.title: 2. Card Gallery
lessons.concept:
### Capstone 2
Build a responsive grid of animated cards.

lessons.title: 3. Dashboard Layout
lessons.concept:
### Capstone 3
Build a complex dashboard using CSS Grid.

lessons.title: 4. Dark Mode Toggle
lessons.concept:
### Capstone 4
Implement a fully working dark/light theme system.

lessons.title: 5. Complete Blog
lessons.concept:
### Capstone 5
Bring everything together in a complete blog site layout.
